title: Travel: George Harrison – London to New York | 1970
content:
George and Pattie Harrison, as well as Derek Taylor, travelled from London to New York on 23 April 1970.

Harrison had had trouble travelling due to a drugs bust the previous year, but had recently been granted a visitor’s visa to the US.

The primary purpose of the trip was for Harrison to begin producing Billy Preston’s fifth studio album, Encouraging Words, and to check out Apple Corps’ new offices at 1700 Broadway in Manhattan. He also recorded with Bob Dylan prior to his return to England on 5 May.
